reason: Frozen after the first real implementation proof so the repeatability trial runs against an unchanged lane.

recorded_harness_failures_before_the_pro.failure: FileNotFoundError: pnpm not resolvable without a shell on Windows
UnicodeDecodeError: subprocess text decoding defaulted to cp1252

freeze_broken_by_defect.defect: No --permission-mode was passed, so the CLI default left sessions with "no approval surface available" and silently denied every Edit and Write. The denial was not consistent between sessions: task 1 and task 2 executors edited files, while task 2 correction and three isolated probes were denied.
freeze_broken_by_defect.how_it_surfaced: The task 2 correction session reported it could not write and produced a diff byte-identical to the executor diff (sha c3f2c0d5c1f8), so the correction changed nothing.
freeze_broken_by_defect.consequence_for_the_trial: Task 2 is recorded as FAILED exactly as observed and is not retried into a success. But its failure is partly attributable to this harness defect: the correction never actually ran, so "at most one correction is too tight" is NOT established by that run.
freeze_broken_by_defect.fix: --permission-mode acceptEdits, which auto-approves edits inside the working directory and nothing else. It does not widen Bash, MCP, network or anything outside the worktree.
freeze_broken_by_defect.verified_by: Three probes: writes denied before the fix, both Edit and Write working after it, each with cleanup verified.

amendment_v3.change: pnpm install now runs with --workspace-concurrency=1 --child-concurrency=1 and a longer timeout.
amendment_v3.why: Task 3 was killed by the host for low memory twice at the dependency-install phase, before any provider session. Host had 1.7 GB free of 31.7 GB.
amendment_v3.classification: Resource management for harness setup. It changes how much memory the setup needs, not the tool allowlist, the containment rules, the correction limit, the authority model or anything the agent may do.

amendment_v4.defect: capture_diff used git diff alone, which covers tracked files only. Files the agent created were referenced by the patch but absent from it, then destroyed with the worktree.
amendment_v4.impact: Run workspace-leave-debt-20260916T074720Z-c502cdc6 is recorded as a success but its work product is unrecoverable: pending-leave.ts and leave-workspace.test.ts are gone. Applying its patch would give a broken build.
amendment_v4.severity: the most serious harness defect in this trial - a run can pass every check and still lose the work
amendment_v4.fix: untracked paths are registered with git add --intent-to-add, by explicit path, before the diff is taken

reason_v5: Deliberate revision between trials, approved by the owner after the first repeatability trial. The second trial runs against this unchanged version; every run refuses to start if any file below differs from these hashes.

per_run_clean_pass_requires_all: the run was admitted: freeze intact, memory floor met, no blocking orphan
executor and reviewer each returned a valid structured verdict; the reviewer's includes out_of_scope_changes
every server-contract warning has a reviewer resolution
no Edit or Write permission denial in any receipt
harness verification passed after the last agent session
no path outside the task's allowed scope
reviewer passed on the first review, with no correction
authority revoked, worktree removed, cleanup guard safe
human check of the patch finds no real defect the reviewer missed and no unrequested change the reviewer failed to list
clean_pass_definition.pass_with_correction: succeeded after the one correction; counts as a pass, not a clean pass
clean_pass_definition.host_blocked_attempt: not a run and not counted either way; recorded; three or more in the trial is itself a reliability finding
trial_is_clean_only_if: five different real tasks, one run each, no reruns
at least four of the five are clean passes and the fifth is at least a pass with correction
zero lane changes during the trial; any lane fix ends the trial as not clean
zero harness failures and zero lost work
zero reviewer misses of a real defect found by the human check
clean_pass_definition.adoption_rule: Adopt the lane as the standard supervised workflow only if the trial is clean. A trial that is not clean is recorded as observed, not retried into a pass.

hash_method: sha256 of file bytes with CRLF normalised to LF

owner_approved: go build, go vet and go test for tasks that declare the go toolchain
orphan sweep before every run: clean leftovers removed, anything holding work blocks the run
mechanical test-fails-before check: product change removed, test kept, verification must fail, change restored byte-for-byte
no JavaScript dependency install for tasks that declare dependencies none
reviewer must return out_of_scope_changes listing every unrequested change
cleanup guard: a worktree holding anything the captured patch lacks is kept and the run fails
host memory floor checked before every run: 4 GB available physical and 4 GB available commit
permission denials, rate-limit frames, API error status and stderr tail kept in every provider receipt

safety_additions_found_while_building.database_isolation: DATABASE_URL points at 127.0.0.1:9 for every command the lane starts. A native PostgreSQL listens on localhost:5432 and the server's DB-backed tests default to that address, so go test access without this could have written fixtures into a real database.
safety_additions_found_while_building.credential_withholding: Environment variables whose names look like credentials are withheld from every command the lane starts. The operator shell held connection strings for four other applications' databases and this session's messaging token; the first trial's executors could have read them through node. No evidence they did.
safety_additions_found_while_building.offline_go: GOPROXY=off and GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly -p=2. GOTOOLCHAIN=local was tried and removed: the host's go 1.26.1 must switch to the module's required 1.26.6 from the local cache.
safety_additions_found_while_building.freeze_enforcement: every run compares these hashes and refuses to start on any difference
safety_additions_found_while_building.regenerable_caches: node_modules, .turbo, .next and *.tsbuildinfo entries do not block cleanup but are recorded; every other new ignored entry blocks it

unchanged: executor tool list and the pre-existing Bash allowlist
revision.known_residual_risk: Running tests means running code the agent wrote, with the operator's user rights. Bash(node:*), vitest and go test all allow that. The boundary is a process and environment boundary, not an operating-system sandbox. Unchanged from the first trial and not closed by this revision.
revision.independent_review: none; the revision was checked by 36 provider-free tests, including real git and an end-to-end run with a stand-in provider, and an offline go test under the sandbox environment

revision.server_contract_check: After every executor or correction session, each field the patch adds as required to a TypeScript zod schema is looked up in the Go server's json tags. A field that is omitempty anywhere becomes a warning in the reviewer prompt, and the reviewer must return exactly one resolution per warning, naming the Go file and struct checked. A missing resolution fails the run mechanically.
revision.replay_on_trial_2: Run 5's real defect (issue_id) is flagged. Runs 1-4 produce 2 warnings (agent_id, token) and run 5 two more (task_id, type), which are name collisions the reviewer must dismiss against the actual endpoint.
revision.reviewer_turns: 6 -> 25, so the reviewer can open the server code a claim depends on
revision.prompts: executor told to read the Go handler and struct, including omitempty, when client code depends on a server response; reviewer asked whether every claim holds for the real system
revision.byte_exact_evidence: final.patch, executor.diff, correction.diff, capture-at-failure.patch and the fails-before product patch are written as bytes, exactly as git produced them
known_limits: the contract check is a name-level heuristic for TypeScript zod schemas only; it does not cover Go-side changes or non-schema claims
running tests still executes agent-written code with the operator's user rights

superseded_freeze_v7.reason: Trial 3 on v6 was ended early by two host memory kills, and applying its two passing runs exposed defects no gate saw: a stricter parser broke an existing test outside the task's new test file, and a new test did not typecheck.

revision.warm_dependency_install: one offline pnpm install per lockfile and scope in a separate reusable worktree (implementation-lane-warm); task worktrees get real node_modules directories whose entries are junctions. Workspace-package entries are redirected to the task worktree's own source so tests never run stale code. Junctions are removed before any recursive delete, in normal cleanup and in the orphan sweep.
revision.dependency_fingerprint: size and mtime of every file in the warm install (27,501 files, about 23 s) before and after each run; a change fails the run and discards the warm install, because an agent could otherwise make its tests pass by editing a dependency
revision.memory_wait: admission and every heavy step wait with backoff (15 s doubling to 120 s) for 2.5 GB available physical and 3.0 GB commit, up to 30 minutes, instead of refusing; only a timeout fails, recorded as host_memory_timeout
revision.memory_sampler: lane process tree working set and host availability sampled every 3 s, peak per run and per phase recorded in outcome.memory
revision.single_worker_tests: trial 4 verification and regression vitest commands use --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
